text.en:
4246
O5FICIAL GAZETIE
The municipality of Dapa shall have its present tor-
ritory minus the barrios and sitios enumerated above
which are included in the municipality of Pilar.
The municipality of Pilar shall begin to exist upon the
appointment and qualification of the mayor, vice-mayor
and a majority of the councilors thereof, and upon the
certification by the Secretary of Finance or the Pro-
vincial Treasurer of Surigao that said municipality is
financially capable of implementing the provisions of the
Minimum Wage Law and at the same time providing
for all the statutory obligations and ordinary essential
services of a regular municipality.
Done in the City of Manila, this 31st day of Octobe:,
in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifty-
three, and of the Independence of the Philippines, the
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
